added.summary: --seed-hud, the game components' light (--hud-accent): by default the accent seed when it has a hue, otherwise the instrument cyan the default style has always drawn with. A pack or a game's --seed-accent (or --seed-primary, which the accent follows) now recolours the light of every family, and a pack may set --seed-hud apart from the accent.

fixed.summary: The built-in components' families (front end, HUD, results, shop, selection, map, quests, cards, world) no longer draw with literal colours: their light derives from --seed-hud, their reward gold (--hud-gold) from --gold, and their grounds, rims and inks from the neutral seed, each held at the lightness it reads at on dark glass in either scheme. A style pack's or a game's seeds now recolour their contents, not only their frames and buttons. The default style looks as before. Rarity, status, tier and team hues stay their own, each written once (--hud-foe, --hud-boon, --hud-warn, --hud-ally, --chart-*), so a pack sets each in one place; the HUD's rare and epic items take --rare and --epic.
In the dark scheme it is the warmer reward gold the game components draw with (#ffcf5a, was #ffd60a).
